en: Changed the Bash tool's shell to clear any inherited `which` alias or function and to stop passing exported `which`/`unsetenv` functions to commands, so `which` is the system command or zsh builtin
zh: 变更 Bash 工具的 shell：清除继承的 `which` 别名或函数，并停止向命令传递导出的 `which`/`unsetenv` 函数，使 `which` 为系统命令或 zsh 内建命令
